messages:
deploy-bot: Finished rollout: inference-api v2.3.1 -> prod (100%). changelist: https://ci/redwood/changes/abc123 :rocket:
jamie (oncall): getting paged: p95 up ~3x, p99 ~5x, spike of 504s across gateways in us-west1. Alerts: alerts/inference-p99-latency, alerts/gateway-5xx-rate :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Pager SRE-1 triggered and assigned to @jamie (oncall). Incident channel created.
luis (sre): on it, joining. any immediate customer reports?
jamie (oncall): some 10s of live customer traces show repeated 504/gateway timeout from proxy -> inference backends. high queueing on model-host pool us-west1-gpu-2.
sara (runtime): NOTE: v2.3.1 included a runtime kernel-selection change (commit abc123) that enabled fast_kv path by default. CI green but limited perf tests.
mike (platform): can we confirm any infra scaling events? autoscaler logs look normal, no node churn.
jamie (oncall): grabbing logs now. posting noisy snippet: ```
[2026-03-15T14:04:12Z] KVCache::wait_for_fill timeout=2000ms key=ctx-9a4
[2026-03-15T14:04:12Z] upstream_request: deadline_exceeded -> 504
[2026-03-15T14:04:13Z] worker: stall detected seq=1024 stall_ms=1800
```
luis (sre): that KV wait looks suspicious. fast_kv could be introducing contention on our async fill path. this matches a deploy-induced regression hypothesis.
sara (runtime): i can roll a quick revert build but given impact we should rollback prod first. agree?
mike (platform): +1 rollback now. reduce blast radius.
jamie (oncall): initiating rollback to v2.3.0. running: ```/deploy rollback inference-api --to v2.3.0 --reason "p99 timeout regression" --no-canary```
deploy-bot: Rollback to inference-api v2.3.0 started by jamie. Expected completion ~90s. Route will be toggled to stable v2.3.0 across prod.
luis (sre): while rollback is in flight: applying a temporary concurrency cap on ingress to avoid cascading queue growth: ```route update inference-api --concurrency 120```
product-notify-bot: Drafting status update: "Customers in us-west experiencing higher timeouts and 5xx; engineering is rolling back a recent runtime change." Will post after confirmation.
jamie (oncall): 60s post-rollback: p95 trending down, p99 falling. 504 rate down from 2.3% -> 0.12% in last 3m.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete: inference-api now serving v2.3.0 (stable).
sara (runtime): confirmed metrics look back to baseline. great catch.
mike (platform): opening incident ticket INC-246891: Severity S2, impact: hosted API customers in us-west, cause: runtime kernel-selection change in v2.3.1 (fast_kv).
jamie (oncall): handing off to luis for deep dive / postmortem. i'll stay on for follow-up for 1h. @luis (sre) you own the investigation and timeline?
luis (sre): taking it. plan: capture flamegraphs from canary, reproduce with fast_kv flag, add kernel telemetry, run small perf matrix, and push hotfix that gates fast_kv behind a feature flag for now. will update INC-246891 with timeline and RCA.
product-notify-bot: Status page posting queued: "Mitigated: Rollback completed, performance restored. Engineers investigating root cause."
jamie (oncall): closing pager. add runbook step: validate KV fill latencies on canary for 30m before full rollout.
sara (runtime): also adding an automated health-check that fails deploy if kv wait > 300ms on canary for 10 consecutive samples.
luis (sre): will own postmortem and owners (runtime + serving). assigning to sara (runtime) and mike (platform) for remediation and process changes.
jamie (oncall): thanks all. I'll mark this as resolved in oncall log and follow up on postmortem. :white_check_mark:
